objective: Observe real search/provider/Agent signals, diagnose admitted pages, perform only bounded source-backed repairs, validate, retest, and feed verified outcomes back into priority without fabricating external success.
truth_laws: UNKNOWN and INCONCLUSIVE are never PASS.

External citations require provider, observed_at, query_or_prompt, surfaced_url, cited_url, and evidence_ref.
Search Intelligence may read Agent outputs but may never mutate Agent-owned paths.
Existing admitted owner routes are repaired before any new URL is considered.
This system has no independent page-admission or publication-cadence authority.
